history.summary: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: the Noida Ayyappa Temple at C-47, C Block, Phase 2, Industrial Area, Sector 62. Built and run by the Noida Ayyappa Sewa Samiti; per the official temple website it 'came into existence in July 2002' with Lord Sastha as the presiding deity, described as 'the divine protector of the whole Noida'. A small, clean community temple serving Noida's Keralite and Malayalee devotees, with monthly Vilakku Pooja, Ayilya Pooja and Dwadasakshari Pradikshanam observances. The Mandala-Makaravilakku season entry is standard for Ayyappa temples but not explicitly confirmed on the site - flag (verify).

name: Ayyappa Temple, Sector 62
town_description: Noida (New Okhla Industrial Development Authority) is a planned industrial city in Gautam Buddha Nagar district, Uttar Pradesh, part of the Delhi NCR. Known for its wide roads, corporate offices and film city, it has a large resident migrant population including Odia, Bengali and Keralite communities, each with its own community temples.
